title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.

Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help companies increase efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences in industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world's leading provider of AI-powered automation software within the next five years.

We work with leading companies such as SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali and others to improve customer interactions and automate business processes using our state-of-the-art Conversational AI technology.

Our global team comprises more than 70 highly qualified professionals from diverse backgrounds.

We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you'll experience a unique blend of passion, ambition, challenge, and fun.

**Tasks**
---------

Enterprise Bot builds agentic AI for voice, chat, email and messaging, deployed by regulated enterprises across Europe, including financial services, insurance and public-sector organisations. We are Swiss-headquartered, which shapes how we approach data sovereignty, privacy and compliance.

The AI market is saturated. New tools launch constantly, and enterprise buyers are struggling to tell platforms apart from wrappers. This role exists to make sure Enterprise Bot is never evaluated as just another AI product. You will own our competitive intelligence, sharpen our positioning, take our product and platform releases to market, advise Product on what the market is telling us, and make all of it consistent in every country we sell in.

This is a builder's role. There is no existing product marketing function, so you will create it.

**What you'll own**

**Product and platform launches, end to end**

* Own the full launch lifecycle for products, platform releases and major features, from early planning through to post-launch performance review
* Define launch tiering, so that a platform-level release and a minor feature receive proportionate investment and internal attention
* Build the launch narrative and the supporting asset set: positioning brief, messaging framework, demo narrative, website and campaign copy, release notes, customer communications and partner briefing material
* Run cross-functional launch readiness across Product, Engineering, Sales, Pre-Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships and Support, including a clear go or no-go checkpoint
* Coordinate with Demand Generation on launch campaigns, and with Partnerships on integrator, BPO and technology partner enablement
* Define launch success metrics up front, including adoption, pipeline influenced, sales confidence and competitive win rate, then report against them and feed the findings into the next launch
* Own the internal launch calendar and keep it aligned with the product release cadence, so that go-to-market readiness is never the constraint on shipping

**Roadmap collaboration (advisory)**

Product owns roadmap prioritisation. Your role is to make sure those decisions are made with clear commercial and competitive evidence in front of them.

* Bring structured market, competitive and buyer evidence into roadmap discussions, so that prioritisation is informed by what the market is telling us rather than by opinion
* Maintain a live view of competitive feature gaps and buyer requirements, particularly around omnichannel orchestration, deployment flexibility, multilingual coverage and compliance, and share it with Product on a regular cadence
* Feed win/loss findings and recurring RFP requirement patterns into the roadmap process as input
* Review planned roadmap items from a market-facing perspective and flag early where a capability will be difficult to differentiate or to sell
* Support roadmap communication to customers, prospects and partners, balancing transparency against commitment risk

**Competitive intelligence**

* Build and maintain a structured view of the competitive landscape across manufacturers, integrators and BPOs, including which players are competitors, which are partner candidates, and which are both
* Establish a formal Win/Loss Analysis programme: define the loss-cause taxonomy, run the debriefs, and turn the findings into action rather than anecdote
* Mine RFP responses as the primary source of competitive truth, since that is where head-to-head comparison actually happens
* Produce and maintain battlecards, objection-handling guides and competitive teardowns that sales can use without translation

**Positioning and messaging**

* Own the core positioning and unify it across geographies. Messaging varies by country today, and that inconsistency costs us
* Translate technical differentiators into buyer-facing value: omnichannel orchestration on a single knowledge and action layer, model-agnostic architecture, on-premise and sovereign deployment options, native multilingual handling, and European compliance readiness
* Adapt positioning to local market realities (Spain, Switzerland, DACH and wider Europe) without fragmenting the core narrative
* Define and maintain the messaging hierarchy, proof points and reference stories

**Website narrative and messaging**

You own what the website says. Demand Generation owns the platform it says it on, and Content owns localisation into market languages.

* Own the messaging and narrative on product, solution and platform pages, so that the site reflects current positioning rather than the positioning of the last launch
* Propose the information architecture and the overall site narrative, including how the platform story is told across pages, and work with Demand Generation to implement it
* Review core pages against positioning on a defined cadence, and keep them current between launches rather than only at launch
* Brief Content on source messaging and market nuance for localisation, and review localised pages for positioning accuracy
* Work with Demand Generation where page messaging and conversion goals pull in different directions, and resolve it on evidence

**Sales enablement**

* Build enablement assets, including pitch decks, one-pagers, demo narratives, and ROI and cost-comparison material
* Support pricing and packaging decisions with competitive and buyer input, including how implementation and professional services are presented in commercial proposals
* Support analyst relations, RFP content libraries and industry event messaging
* Run enablement sessions so that new positioning and new releases actually reach the field, and check that they land

**Voice of the market**

* Run structured customer and prospect interviews to keep positioning grounded in what buyers actually say
* Feed market and competitive signal back into product prioritisation on a regular cadence

**Requirements**
----------------

**Required**

* 5+ years in product marketing within B2B technology, SaaS or enterprise software
* Demonstrable experience marketing to enterprise buyers with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
* Proven ownership of product and platform launches end to end, not only the asset production within someone else’s launch plan
* Direct working experience with Product and Engineering teams, including contributing market and competitive evidence to roadmap discussions
* Proven ownership of competitive analysis and positioning, not only campaign execution
* Experience owning product and solution page messaging on a company website, including keeping it aligned to positioning over time
* Strong written English, with the ability to turn technical capability into commercial argument
* Experience working with distributed sales teams across multiple countries
* Comfort operating with European working hours for part of the day

**Strongly preferred**

* Background in conversational AI, CCaaS, contact centre technology, automation or adjacent categories
* Experience marketing into regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, healthcare or public sector
* Familiarity with European compliance frameworks (GDPR, DORA and sector certifications) as buying criteria
* Experience with on-premise or hybrid deployment models, not SaaS only
* Experience launching platform products rather than single-channel point solutions
* Exposure to partner and channel go-to-market

**How we'll know you're the right fit**

* You can look at a crowded category and articulate why one product is structurally different, not simply better marketed
* You can walk us through a launch you owned end to end, including what you would do differently
* You have run a win/loss programme, or built one from nothing
* You can influence a roadmap you do not control by bringing evidence rather than pressure, and you are equally comfortable telling Sales when the positioning is wrong.

**First 90 days**

* **Days 1 to 30:** Competitive landscape mapped and classified. Ten win/loss interviews completed across recent deals. Launch process and release cadence understood, with current gaps documented.
* **Days 31 to 60:** Core positioning documented and validated with the CEO and regional sales leads. First battlecards in the hands of sales. Launch framework and tiering agreed with Product.
* **Days 61 to 90:** Unified messaging framework rolled out across markets. Win/loss programme running on a repeatable cadence. First launch owned end to end under the new framework, with success metrics reported.

**Benefits**
------------

* **Shape a function from the ground up** – Build Enterprise Bot's first Product Marketing function and have a direct impact on product strategy, positioning and go-to-market.
* **Work with cutting-edge AI** – Help define the market narrative for an enterprise-grade agentic AI platform used by leading financial services, insurance and public sector organisations across Europe.
* **Global exposure** – Collaborate daily with Product, Engineering and commercial teams across Switzerland, Spain, Poland, the UK and other European markets.
* **High ownership, low bureaucracy** – Take ownership of launches, competitive strategy and messaging, with the autonomy to influence business decisions and work directly with senior leadership.
* **Competitive salary and performance-based incentives** – We offer a competitive compensation package aligned to experience and impact.

This is a unique opportunity to build a Product Marketing function from the ground up and influence how Enterprise Bot competes and grows across Europe. If that excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Demand Generation and Growth Manager
description:
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.

Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help companies increase efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences in industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world's leading provider of AI-powered automation software within the next five years.

We work with leading companies such as SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali and others to improve customer interactions and automate business processes using our state-of-the-art Conversational AI technology.

Our global team comprises more than 70 highly qualified professionals from diverse backgrounds.

We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you'll experience a unique blend of passion, ambition, challenge, and fun.

**Tasks**
---------

Enterprise Bot builds agentic AI for voice, chat, email and messaging, and sells it to large enterprises in deals with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement scrutiny and real compliance requirements.

Our growth constraint is not awareness. It is qualified, sales-ready pipeline in the accounts we actually want. This role owns that pipeline. You will design, run and optimise the programmes that generate and convert demand across Europe, and you will be measured on pipeline and revenue contribution rather than on lead volume.

**What you'll own:**

**Pipeline generation**

* Own the demand generation strategy and quarterly pipeline targets by region and segment
* Design and run integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, content syndication, SEO, email and webinars
* Build and run account-based marketing programmes against a defined target account list, in tight coordination with sales
* Develop the outbound support layer: sequences, content and intent-based targeting that make SDR and AE outreach land

**Funnel ownership and conversion**

* Own the funnel end to end, from traffic and conversion through MQL, SQL, opportunity and closed-won, and diagnose where it leaks
* Build and maintain lead scoring, routing and nurture flows so that sales receives genuinely qualified handoffs
* Run structured experimentation on landing pages, offers, messaging and channel mix
* Improve conversion rates on existing traffic before spending to increase it

**Marketing operations and measurement**

* Own the marketing automation and CRM stack (HubSpot), including workflows, lifecycle stages, data hygiene and attribution
* Build reporting that connects spend to pipeline to revenue, and report it honestly to leadership
* Manage the demand generation budget with clear accountability for cost per opportunity and pipeline ROI

**Website ownership**

* You own the website as a platform and as a conversion asset. Product Marketing owns the messaging on
* core product and solution pages, and Content owns localisation into market languages.
* Own the website platform and CMS, including the publishing workflow, page templates, governance and release process
* Own technical SEO and site performance, including site structure, page speed, indexation, structured data and Core Web Vitals
* Own site analytics and tracking, including tag management, event tracking, consent management and the attribution model
* Build and optimise landing pages and campaign pages, and run continuous conversion rate optimisation across the site
* Implement the information architecture and site narrative proposed by Product Marketing, and challenge it where it conflicts with conversion or search performance
* Coordinate with Content on the rollout and technical implementation of localised pages, including hreflang and market-level site structure
* Manage external web development or agency resource where required

**Programmes and partners**

* Run the webinar and event programme, including field and industry events across Europe and India
* Build co-marketing programmes with integrators, BPOs and technology partners
* Work with Product Marketing so that campaign messaging reflects current positioning rather than drifting from it
* Support product and platform launches with the demand side of the launch plan

**Requirements**
----------------

* 5+ years in demand generation, growth or performance marketing within B2B technology, SaaS or enterprise software
* Track record generating pipeline for enterprise deals with long, complex sales cycles, rather than SMB or self-serve motions
* Hands-on expertise with marketing automation and CRM, ideally HubSpot. You build the workflows yourself
* Hands-on website ownership experience, including working directly in a CMS, and practical technical SEO capability rather than oversight of someone else doing it
* Working knowledge of web analytics and tag management implementation, including event tracking and consent requirements under GDPR
* Strong analytical capability across funnel diagnostics, attribution, and cohort and channel analysis
* Demonstrated ABM experience against named enterprise accounts
* Paid media management experience with real budget accountability
* Strong written English
* Comfort operating with European working hours for part of the day

**Strongly preferred**

* Experience marketing to European enterprise buyers, particularly in financial services or insurance
* Background in conversational AI, CCaaS, contact centre or enterprise automation categories
* Experience running multilingual campaigns across European markets, and managing a multilingual website structure
* SQL or advanced analytics capability
* Experience in a company scaling from founder-led sales toward a repeatable marketing engine

**How we’ll know you are the right fit**

* You talk in pipeline and revenue, not impressions and MQLs
* You can point to specific programmes you built and the pipeline they produced
* You have killed a channel that was not working, and can explain how you knew

**First 90 days**

* **Days 1 to 30:** Full funnel audit complete. Baseline metrics established by channel and region. Website technical SEO and tracking audit complete, with gaps identified.
* **Days 31 to 60:** Target account list agreed with sales. First ABM programme live. The two or three highest-potential channels prioritised and resourced.
* **Days 61 to 90:** Repeatable campaign cadence running. Pipeline reporting live and trusted by sales leadership. A clear view of cost per opportunity by channel.

**Benefits**
------------

* **Shape a function from the ground up** – Build Enterprise Bot's first Product Marketing function and have a direct impact on product strategy, positioning and go-to-market.
* **Work with cutting-edge AI** – Help define the market narrative for an enterprise-grade agentic AI platform used by leading financial services, insurance and public sector organisations across Europe.
* **Global exposure** – Collaborate daily with Product, Engineering and commercial teams across Switzerland, Spain, Poland, the UK and other European markets.
* **High ownership, low bureaucracy** – Take ownership of launches, competitive strategy and messaging, with the autonomy to influence business decisions and work directly with senior leadership.
* **Competitive salary and performance-based incentives** – We offer a competitive compensation package aligned to experience and impact.

This is a unique opportunity to build a Growth Marketing function from the ground up and influence how Enterprise Bot competes and grows across Europe. If that excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

This role of Marketing Executive will support the Senior Marketing Manager of our Specialty business within the Financial Lines and Crisis Management teams. Additionally, they will provide support to the newly created Private Equity and M&A P&L. They should be a high-performing, self-motivated individual who can manage multiple projects successfully to achieve exceptional commercial results.

Our marketing activities focus on three core objectives:  
Distinguishing the Gallagher brand from our peers;  
Thought-leadership and insight-led campaigns that drive organic sales leads and revenue opportunities;  
Contributing to a differentiated client experience that deepens retention and advocacy.

The Marketing Executive will play an integral role in creating value for clients through the delivery of integrated sales & marketing plans and campaigns that align to each business’s specific objectives and deliver on Gallagher’s near-term and longer-term growth aspirations. This includes effective collaboration within the broader marketing and communications team.

In addition to supporting the Specialty business, the Marketing Executive will also contribute to Gallagher’s European marketing efforts, ensuring content and activity is aligned with regional strategies.

The Marketing Executive will contribute to the delivery of our digital and social marketing plans to reach and engage target audiences. The aim is to increase conversion, improve customer journeys, and enhance the user experience throughout. This includes a focus on web metrics and ROI reporting.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Support senior marketing colleagues in delivering marketing plans to support our corporate, divisional, and business aims.
* Ensure all marketing activity is grounded in a strong understanding of business goals, products, industry, customer needs, and competitive opportunities.
* Ensure all marketing activity follows the processes and best practices required to deliver excellent results.
* Collaborate with internal marketing colleagues to ensure that marketing plans are agreed upon, delivered to deadline, and achieve the desired results. Frequently evaluate activity against the plan and review post-completion for areas to improve.
* Understand campaign KPIs and communicate clearly back to the marketing team as required, particularly analytics.
* Proactively identify new marketing opportunities as well as respond to requests from marketing colleagues.
* Be creative in the approach to marketing and be willing to test and trial new activities.  
  Challenge the boundaries of marketing, ensuring all forms of media and channels are deployed when delivering campaigns.
* Ensure necessary compliance sign-off for marketing activities, including FinProms approval.  
  Monitor industry and wider marketing best practices, as well as the activities of competitors, to ensure we stay one step ahead.
* Write compelling and effective copy for marketing campaigns, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and tone of voice.
* Brief relevant teams, including creative and digital teams, to ensure the successful execution of marketing activities.

**Stakeholder accountabilities**

  

* Develop key relationships within the wider marketing community and across the Gallagher group.
* Work with Sales, Marketing & Communication colleagues to ensure marketing activity is joined up to deliver customer-centric and best in class marketing.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of our core customer groups.

**Operational excellence**

* Apply project and campaign management tools and best practice to ensure projects are delivered effectively, efficiently and to budget.
* Always look for efficiencies in respect of how the team is working; identify issues and challenges early on and work with Senior Marketing Managers to develop tangible ways to improve performance.
* Understand the changing regulatory and legal environment around marketing activities, ensure risks are factored in to all strategies and activities, flagging potential risks as required to senior management and putting in place all measures to suitable mitigate risk.
* Adhere to brand guidelines and become an active champion of the brand.
    
  Ensure necessary FinProms/compliance sign off is obtained in a timely fashion and in full adherence with corporate policies.
* Carry out duties following internal policies and procedures in accordance with applicable laws, rules, regulation, good governance and Gallagher’s shared values, in particular, putting customers at the heart of our business.

  
  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**

* Educated to degree standard or higher (desirable) or equivalent experience.

**Experience:**

* 3+ years of marketing experience in either a commercial sector or agency setting, ideally financial services.
* Execution of social media and email marketing campaigns.
* Execution of marketing projects adhering to best practice marketing principles.
* Experience of delivery of End-to-End marketing campaigns.
* Experience of managing internal stakeholders, and working as part of a wider marketing function.

**Skills/other**

* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively.
* Results-driven mindset.
* Exceptional project management skills.
* Acute attention to detail.
* Builds rapport easily with colleagues and gains trust.
* Working within structured project methodology and reporting.
* Excellent planning skills and ability to anticipate future outcomes and manage risks to projects.
* Ability to meet consistently high quality standards whilst managing a variety of projects and deadlines.
* Experience of using email client software, Linkedin, website CMS, Google analytics, Adobe creative software desirable.
* MS Office expertise.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership

title: Senior Manager, AI Build, the^delta Prize
description:
**About the Team:**

https://thedelta.org.in/prize/ is a platform to draw talent, capital, and public attention towards the most pressing developmental problems in India. the^delta Prize aims to guide markets where they are needed the most, inducing population-scale solutions and innovations that have disproportionate impact on stagnant livelihood opportunities and ecosystems for underserved segments. We research, design and conduct tech-based scale-up competitions to discover and innovate disruptive solutions, and pull in capital to solve the most complex problems in India, faster.

This role sits within Future Enterprises, the^delta Prize's vertical dedicated to India's MSME sector, and leads day-to-day product and delivery of the AI platform within Samriddhi (AI for MSME prosperity). Samriddhi runs through two approaches: Grand Challenges, and an AI-first platform that connects youth and jobseekers in tier 3–4 cities to career pathways, skilling, apprenticeships and jobs, while helping MSMEs access job-ready talent. The role reports to the Director / Associate Director, AI & Digital Platforms, and works closely with the Senior Managers leading Challenges and Convening & Ecosystem.

**Who are we solving for?**

Youth and jobseekers in tier 3–4 cities, whose access to career guidance, skilling and jobs is limited by language, geography and the thin guidance available to them. The platform also serves MSMEs that find it difficult to articulate their hiring requirements and reach job-ready talent.

**What are we solving for?**

India's youth-to-work transition is fragmented across three points. Skilling remains supply-led while MSME demand for talent goes largely unmet. Career guidance for tier 3–4 youth is thin, rarely personalised, and rarely available in the youth's own language or in a voice-first format. The existing landscape of job and skilling platforms is fragmented, with several credible players serving overlapping segments through incompatible systems, which makes duplication the main design risk.

The platform is designed to address these three points together, and to run on top of existing government-led skilling councils, job and skilling networks and education-employment infrastructure instead of building parallel rails. The ambition is to reach 10–12 million young people over three years.

**Role and Responsibility:**

**What will you do?**

* Own day-to-day product delivery of the AI platform, translating the Director's direction into roadmaps, requirements, sprint priorities and release plans
* Work hands-on with engineering and AI partners: write product requirements, review architecture and technical trade-offs, test builds, and hold partners to agreed timelines and quality
* Lead the design, build and evaluation of the platform's AI features, including LLM-based conversational and recommendation features, retrieval over structured and unstructured data, and multilingual and voice-first interaction, with prompt design, evaluation benchmarks and human-in-the-loop review
* Run structured user research with youth and MSME employers in tier 3–4 cities, and convert the findings into product decisions
* Lead the landscape scan of existing job and skilling platforms across function, technology used, UI/UX design intent and ownership model, and turn it into build, buy, partner or integrate recommendations
* Scope and manage integrations with government and ecosystem digital infrastructure, using open APIs and interoperable data standards
* Define product metrics (adoption, retention, completion, placement outcomes and AI response quality), set up analytics, and report on them regularly
* Establish Responsible AI practices for every AI feature shipped, covering transparency, fairness testing, safety and escalation processes, and data privacy and consent
* Onboard platform partners across technology, skilling, employers and institutions, and maintain those relationships through continuous engagement
* Interface with the Challenges and Convening & Ecosystem teams, and with marketing, analytics, impact and donor relations, on areas critical to the platform's success
* Manage and mentor the Senior Associate on the platform team

*(The actual role might evolve slightly based on your relevant experience and the overlap between organisational requirements and your interests.)*

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

***Core abilities & transferable skills***

* Strong product judgement: ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements and priorities
* Working fluency in AI and LLM systems, enough to make and challenge consequential technical decisions with engineering partners
* Ability to evaluate AI quality in a structured way, including in Indian languages and voice-first settings
* Exceptional stakeholder and relationship management skills across technology partners, government bodies and institutions
* Ability to think in first principles and understand second- and third-order change or impact
* Comfort managing flux and change in a platform that will evolve as it is built
* Bias for action, paired with humility

***Apply if you have:***

* Graduate or postgraduate degree
* 8–12 years of experience in product, technology or platform roles in high-performing set-ups, including direct ownership of at least one shipped digital product used at scale
* Hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation and monitoring of model outputs, and human-in-the-loop workflows
* Working understanding of APIs, data pipelines and platform architecture, sufficient to review technical decisions made by engineering partners
* Experience managing external engineering or AI partners, without relying on a large in-house technology team
* Experience with user research and analytics-led product iteration
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, and proficiency in documentation and presentation tools
* Willingness to travel to pilot locations in tier 3–4 geographies
* Willingness to work in a fast-paced, start-up environment
* Comfort with some degree of ambiguity in the absence of perfect information

***Would be great if you have:***

* Experience building multilingual, voice-first or low-bandwidth products for Indian languages
* Experience with DPI/DPGs, open or interoperable platforms, or government digital systems
* Experience in edtech, skilling, jobs, livelihoods or MSME-facing products
* Familiarity with Responsible AI frameworks and practices
* Work experience in a tech start-up
* Prior experience in the social or impact sector
* Interest in developmental economics and India's youth employment and MSME landscape

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals, irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

title: Senior P&C Coordinator
description:

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.*

* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners*
* *Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category*
* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*

**How We Work**

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the** **Position**

As Senior P&C Coordinator, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the employee experience at Energy Exemplar, supporting assigned business functions across India. As the day-to-day P&C contact for managers and employees, you’ll build trusted relationships, understand team priorities and turn employee feedback and people data into practical recommendations that make a difference.

You’ll take ownership of key moments in the employee journey, from welcoming new starters and supporting probation through to offboarding, coordinating with relevant teams to deliver a smooth and positive experience. You’ll also help bring people programmes to life, guide managers through established policies and processes, and partner with the Senior Director, P&C on sensitive or complex matters.

This opportunity will suit someone who enjoys connecting with people, solving problems and taking initiative. How you work matters as much as what you deliver. We are looking for someone who brings a positive, constructive attitude, contributes to team success, actively seeks and applies feedback, and takes initiative to follow things through. The role offers opportunities to broaden your contribution and responsibility as you demonstrate sound judgment, consistent delivery and impact.

  

**Key Accountabilities and Duties**

* Provide quality, timely and professional P&C advice to managers and employees on established people processes and policies and build effective working relationships with stakeholders across assigned functions.

* Partner with managers to understand business priorities, team capability needs, employee motivations and retention risks, and help translate these into practical people actions for their teams.

* Support the delivery of performance and development processes, including goal and review cycles, development plans, talent discussions and follow-up on agreed actions.

* Work with managers to interpret engagement survey results and employee feedback, identify themes, agree relevant actions and monitor progress.

* Be accountable for the onboarding experience for employees, including Energy Exemplar’s sign-to-start programme, manager readiness, induction coordination and probation follow-up. Identify opportunities to improve the new-joiner experience.

* Conduct 30, 60 and 90 day new-joiner check-ins to assess the onboarding experience, identify issues requiring follow-up and share themes with managers and P&C leadership.

* Coordinate employee changes and offboarding, conduct exit interviews where appropriate, and identify themes and recommendations for action.

* Ensure the accurate and timely administration and safekeeping of employee records, HRIS information and documentation in line with local requirements and Global P&C processes.

* Produce accurate and informative reports, including headcount, attrition, onboarding, engagement and employee movements, and share insights and recommendations with relevant stakeholders.

* Collaborate with the Global P&C team and internal partners to deliver consistent people processes and employee experiences across locations and suggest improvements to established practices.

* Escalate sensitive employee relations matters, disciplinary issues, separations, compensation or policy exceptions, and significant people risks to the Senior Director, P&C for review and decision.

* Use approved AI tools where appropriate to improve the quality and efficiency of P&C communications, reporting, analysis and routine workflows; verify outputs before use and protect confidential employee information.

  

**Candidate Requirements**

* Constructive attitude and teamwork: Approaches challenges with a practical, solution-focused mindset, supports colleagues and contributes to shared outcomes. Willingly takes on the detailed and routine work needed to deliver a strong employee experience.

* Coachability and self-awareness: Actively seeks feedback, listens openly, takes responsibility for errors and demonstrates how learning translates into improved performance.

* Initiative and follow-through: Identifies what needs attention, recommends practical action and follows through on commitments without repeated prompting. Knows when to act independently and when to seek guidance.

* Learning and growth: Shows curiosity about the business and the P&C profession, applies new learning and builds credibility through the quality and impact of their work.

* Collaborative confidence: Listens to different perspectives, shares credit and adapts their approach when presented with better information. Can respectfully question an approach and offer an alternative.

* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in an HR generalist or people advisory role, including direct support to managers; experience in a product technology or software environment is an advantage.

* Working understanding of India employment practices, HR compliance and relevant labour legislation, with the judgment to recognise when specialist advice is needed.

* Experience supporting employee lifecycle processes, performance and engagement programmes, and interpreting people data to recommend actions.

* Ability to build trust with managers and employees, ask thoughtful questions, communicate clearly and follow issues through to resolution.

* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to balance portfolio priorities and deliver accurate work in a changing environment.

* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with BambooHR or a similar HRIS is desirable.

* AI readiness: confidence using approved AI tools for drafting, analysis and routine workflows; ability to write useful prompts, verify results against source information, recognise errors or bias, and handle employee data in line with company requirements.

  

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management or related field

title: Digital CX Tech Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

  

The Digital CX Technology Analyst prepares and manages the data, systems and processes that power our digital customer success strategy. The role identifies, collects and prepares data, primarily from Snowflake, and enables its effective use across Gainsight CS, Gainsight PX and Journey Orchestrator. Working closely with functional leaders, the analyst supports projects spanning planning, reporting, goal setting, customer health, business process optimisation and the operational metrics required to scale Customer Success. The role owns platform data integrity, helps design business rules that analyse customer data and trigger digital customer success actions, and contributes to a scalable customer lifecycle from onboarding through renewal. This is a cross-functional role partnering with Customer Success Operations, Sales Operations, Corporate Technology Data Enablement and Sales Technology, Marketing, Product, Support, Sales Strategy and Execution, and other teams to ensure technology initiatives are prioritised against Customer Success objectives. It combines solution design with hands-on work across backend data systems and customer-facing journey orchestration, and provides development towards a solution architecture career path.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and maintain the roadmap of systems, tools and data capabilities needed to support Customer Success, including resource planning, project management, customer health tracking and operational business metrics.

* Identify opportunities to improve Customer Success effectiveness, efficiency, scalability and financial performance, and translate those opportunities into practical technology and process improvements.

* Own platform data integrity and coordinate the sources, metrics, frequency and level of data required for digital customer success use cases.

* Identify, extract, transform and prepare data, primarily from Snowflake, so it can be used effectively within Gainsight CS, Gainsight PX and Journey Orchestrator.

* Configure and deploy Gainsight and Salesforce capabilities for internal users, including system configuration, integrations, reports, dashboards, workflows and business rules.

* Design and manage rules that analyse customer data and trigger scalable digital programmes across the customer lifecycle, from onboarding through adoption, health management and renewal.

* Partner with Sales Operations and Customer Success Operations to establish and maintain role-based metrics and insights, including customer health indicators, renewal performance, territory and account planning, organisational performance, customer lifecycle measures and Voice of Customer feedback.

* Enable colleagues to use customer data effectively within Gainsight, particularly through Journey Orchestrator, and prepare Customer Success teams for new processes, tools and functionality.

* Coordinate delivery of Customer Success enablement programmes, tools and processes, clearly communicating priorities, activities, dependencies and outcomes to stakeholders.

* Establish practical processes that help CSMs work effectively with cross-functional teams, including onboarding plans that bring new CSMs up to speed efficiently.

* Translate data into scalable customer journeys and product messaging, balancing technical design, customer experience and operational requirements.

* Structure data and solutions in an efficient, lean and cost-conscious way so digital journeys can scale across Data & Analytics and Risk Intelligence product suites.

* Recommend and support adoption of best practices and standardised procedures that improve consistency and reduce manual effort.

* Provide second-line platform support and coordinate issue resolution with Gainsight Support, the Gainsight Technical Account Manager and Corporate Technology partners.

Manage multiple strategic and operational projects in a fast-paced environment, adapting priorities as business needs evolve and supporting the team’s ambition to operate natively with AI.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

  

* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Experience in a SaaS or recurring-revenue business, ideally within Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or a related operational function.

* Hands-on Gainsight administration experience, including Gainsight CS and Gainsight PX, with experience maintaining a Gainsight and Salesforce Customer Success platform model.

* Gainsight Administration certification required; Salesforce Administration certification preferred.

* Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, including extracting and preparing data for downstream use.

* Strong SQL skills and experience working across backend data systems, integrations, reports, dashboards and workflows.

* Experience with Journey Orchestrator or a similar journey or workflow orchestration tool.

* Strong data analysis, reporting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn business requirements into scalable technology solutions.

* Demonstrated ability to understand and meet internal or external customer needs.

* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple and competing priorities.

* Sound business judgement, with the ability to see the bigger picture, prioritise effectively and act in an environment of change and ambiguity.

* Comfort working with high-performing teams in an indirect and matrixed capacity, taking initiative and maintaining disciplined execution.

Interest in solution architecture and in designing data and technology structures for long-term scalability, not only immediate delivery needs.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

title: Field Marketing Specialist (Contract)
description:
**Company Description**

Freshworks makes it fast and easy for businesses to delight their customers and employees. We do this by taking a fresh approach to building and delivering software that is affordable, quick to implement, and designed for the end user. Headquartered in **San Mateo, California**, Freshworks has a global team operating from **13 global locations** to serve more than 65,000 companies - from startups to public companies – that rely on Freshworks software-as-a-service to enable a better customer experience (CRM, CX) and employee experience (ITSM).

Freshworks’ cloud-based software suite includes **Freshdesk** (omni-channel customer support), **Freshsales** (sales automation), **Freshmarketer** (marketing automation), **Freshservice** (IT service desk), **Freshchat** (AI-powered bots), supported by Neo, our underlying platform of shared services.

Freshworks is featured in global national press including CNBC, Forbes, Fortune, Bloomberg and has been a BuiltIn Best Place to work in San Francisco and Denver for the last 3 years. Our customer ratings have earned Freshworks products TrustRadius Top Rated Software ratings and G2 Best of Awards for Best Feature Set, Best Value for the Price and Best Relationship.

 **Job Description**

We’re looking for an execution-driven Field Marketing Specialist to run events, webinars and field programs, primarily across India with support for APMEA. You’ll run the show end-to-end, from planning and delivery through follow-up, reporting and learnings, and build the foundations that let every campaign and event execute smoothly. You’ll work closely with the Regional Marketing Manager, Sales, and cross-functional teams (Ops, procurement, finance, etc.)

This isn’t a “follow-the-playbook” role. We need a genuine doer with strong business sense, someone who sees the bigger picture, keeps many moving parts on track, and is always asking, “How can we do this better?”

What You’ll Do

* Support the execution of physical, virtual and third-party events, roundtables and webinars, from concept to post-event follow-up, with a focus on high engagement and ROI. As you grow in the role, you’ll take on a bigger part in planning and strategic discussions for in-region activity.
* Own the operational side: manage budgets, timelines, and vendors and agencies, from vendor PR paperwork and POs through to invoices, while keeping trackers current and working with procurement and finance to deliver on time and within budget.
* Work jointly with Marketing Operations on campaign setup, lead and attendee uploads, and Salesforce tracking, so leads reach Sales promptly.
* Work with the local field marketing owners across the various programs and ABM activations across India, and support scaled campaigns across APMEA.
* Manage vendors, agencies, event logistics and swag, evaluating third-party event opportunities and making every dollar count.
* Work with brand, content and design teams to deliver assets on time and on brand.
* Build reports and analysis of campaign performance, spot trends, and turn learnings into clear recommendations for Sales and Marketing on what to repeat, fix or stop.
* Experiment with AI tools to automate reporting, tracking and follow-ups, and to scale campaign reach.

 **Qualifications**

* 4-7 years in B2B SaaS or enterprise tech marketing, with experience running field programs, events and webinars end-to-end. You’ve run the show, not just supported it.
* Strong business acumen: you connect programs to pipeline and business priorities, think big, and make smart trade-offs on budget and investment.
* Solid operational foundations: experience with budgets, vendors, agencies, procurement, POs and invoicing, and project tracking, and you know what it takes to set a program up to execute well.
* A self-starter with a strong bias for action, who manages multiple fast-moving priorities independently without losing sight of the details.
* Data confidence and Salesforce (or similar CRM) fluency. You understand what the data means and use it to improve campaigns.
* Experience working across Sales, Marketing Operations, procurement, finance, and brand, content and design teams.
* A sales-centric mindset and genuine interest in how sales teams work and win.
* Curiosity about ABM and AI tools, and comfort using them to work smarter.
* Comfortable supporting programs across multiple markets and time zones.
* Fluent English and clear communication.
* Willingness to travel when needed

 **Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Global Social Media Manager
description:

We're looking for a strategic, creative, and execution-oriented social media leader to own the global organic social media presence for Esko and its owned brands, including TraceGains and Artwork Flow.

This role develops and executes social strategy, creates and publishes content, grows and engages audiences, amplifies executive and employee voices, and measures performance across channels. Equal parts strategist and hands-on creator, this person will turn company narratives, customer stories, product innovation, industry insights, events, and thought leadership into social programs that build awareness, strengthen industry influence, and support business growth.

This is a hands-on role. The Global Social Media Manager will set the strategy and execute it, including writing posts, designing social assets, shooting and editing videos, managing the editorial calendar, publishing content, engaging with the community, and optimizing performance.

* Own the global organic social media strategy, execution, and performance for TraceGains and Esko.
* Manage the social editorial calendar, content planning process, publishing schedule, and performance reporting.
* Develop audience, channel, content, and advocacy programs that build brand awareness, strengthen thought leadership, and increase industry influence.
* Create and publish social-first content, including written posts, graphics, carousels, and short-form video.
* Transform company narratives, customer stories, product innovation, events, and research into engaging social programs.
* Lead executive thought leadership and employee advocacy initiatives.
* Build and engage social communities while monitoring trends, conversations, and market opportunities.
* Partner across Marketing, Communications, Product, and Commercial teams to integrate social media into strategic initiatives.

title: Sr. Mgr, Sales & Marketing, Amazon Smart Commerce
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Lead the end-to-end go-to-market organization for Amazon Smart Commerce, AI-first, agentic solution for emerging D2C brands. Own sales, marketing, account management, partnerships and international expansion, with responsibility for delivering ambitious growth and adoption goals.  
  
Smart Commerce is building the next generation of commerce solutions to help emerging brands start, operate and grow their businesses. We are looking for an entrepreneurial GTM leader to define and execute our growth strategy in India and expand the business into international markets.  
  
This leader will build and lead a high-performing organization spanning Sales, Marketing, Account Management and Partnerships. The ideal candidate has a strong track record of scaling software or technology businesses, preferably serving D2C brands or SMBs, and consistently delivering outsized results.  
  
The role requires strong commercial judgment, customer obsession and the ability to move seamlessly between strategy and execution. Experience in digital and performance marketing, building agentic solution is highly preferred.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own Smart Commerce GTM strategy and execution across Sales, Marketing, Account Management, Partnerships and International Expansion.  
  
Deliver ambitious goals across customer acquisition, adoption, retention and revenue growth.  
  
Build, lead and develop a high-performing GTM organization and leadership team.  
  
Define customer segmentation, sales motions, coverage models and scalable GTM playbooks.  
  
Develop demand-generation programs across performance marketing, lifecycle marketing, events and partnerships.  
  
Build deep understanding of D2C brands, their economics and pain points, and translate insights into growth opportunities.  
  
Identify new customer segments, channels, partnerships and international expansion opportunities.  
  
Establish operating mechanisms and metrics across pipeline, conversion, productivity, retention and customer growth.  
  
Partner closely with Product and Tech to bring customer insights into roadmap prioritization and successfully launch new AI and agentic capabilities.  
  
Build strategic relationships with founders, senior customers and ecosystem partners.  
  
Hire and develop strong leaders while creating a culture of ownership, customer obsession and delivering results.  
  
Influence senior stakeholders across Amazon on GTM strategy, priorities and investments.  
  
About the team  
Smart Commerce helps emerging brands succeed in an increasingly complex, multi-channel commerce environment.  
  
Our vision is to build an AI-first, agentic partner for D2C brands that simplifies how businesses acquire customers, sell online, manage orders and operate across channels.  
  
The team brings together Product, Technology and Go-to-Market capabilities and operates with a builder mindset. We start with India while building solutions and GTM models that can scale internationally.  
  
The Head of Sales & Marketing will be a key member of the Smart Commerce leadership team and will help shape both our growth strategy and the future direction of the business.

* Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross functional teams or equivalent
* Experience in strategic thinking about business, enterprise software products, and new technology platforms and architectures or equivalent

----------------------------

* 7+ years of managing and developing high performance teams experience

title: Marketing Executive - Banking
description:
Job Description – Marketing Associate (CASA & Loan Products)

Job Summary

The Marketing Associate will be responsible for promoting the Bank’s CASA (Current Account and Savings Account) products and loan products, generating leads, engaging with prospective customers, and supporting branch-level sales and loan processing activities. Candidates will be assigned to Sales Officers at designated branch locations and will primarily work in the field to acquire new customers and build strong customer relationships.

Roles & Responsibilities

* Promote and market the Bank’s CASA products and loan offerings to prospective customers.
* Engage with customers face-to-face to understand their banking and financial requirements and explain suitable products.
* Provide basic information on loan products, including features, eligibility criteria, documentation requirements, and application procedures.
* Conduct field visits to meet prospective and existing customers, develop relationships, and identify new business opportunities.
* Identify potential High-Net-Worth Individual (HNI) customers, schedule appointments, and promote relevant banking products.
* Participate in Bank-organized events, campaigns, and conferences to generate leads and expand the customer base.
* Coordinate with Sales Officers, Branch Managers, and internal teams to facilitate customer acquisition and smooth loan processing.
* Assist in collecting, verifying, and submitting customer documents in accordance with the Bank’s prescribed procedures.
* Ensure loan applications and supporting documents are complete and handed over to the concerned teams on time.
* Follow up with customers regarding application status, documentation, queries, and other banking requirements.
* Maintain regular customer interactions to provide process updates and support customer satisfaction.
* Adhere to Bank policies, compliance requirements, and ethical standards while conducting marketing and sales activities.

Eligibility Criteria

* **Age:** 18–40 years
* **Qualification:** Graduate in any stream

* **Skills:** Good communication, interpersonal, customer-handling, and marketing skills.
* **Job Nature:** Primarily field-based sales and customer acquisition.
* **Deployment:** Candidates will be assigned to Sales Officers at designated Bank branch locations.

Compensation & Incentives

* **Monthly CTC:** ₹21,379, subject to applicable statutory deductions and the terms specified in the Job Description.
* **Performance Incentives:** Up to ₹42,000, based on achievement of assigned targets and applicable incentive criteria.

Key Performance Expectations

* Achievement of assigned CASA and loan-product sales targets.
* Effective lead generation, customer acquisition, and conversion.
* Timely collection and submission of customer documentation.
* Consistent field activity, customer follow-ups, and relationship building.
* Compliance with Bank procedures and service standards.

title: Digital Product Specialist, Customer Content
description:

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  
  
DESCRIPTION:  
Thermo Fisher is seeking a highly motivated individual to serve as Digital Product Specialist, Customer Content.

As a Product Specialist, you will be responsible for the management and evolution of the enterprise Customer Content platform used across Thermo Fisher Scientific. Together with the Senior Product Manager, own the product strategy, roadmap, backlog prioritization, and requirements definition for the Thermo Fisher Marketing Content DAM (AEM as a Cloud Service Assets) and the connected technologies comprising the Customer Content Supply Chain.

Your primary focus will be on defining and driving capabilities of our enterprise-wide platform to maximize value, including through the implementation of automations to enable production and management of on-brand Customer Content at scale.

The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of Marketing and Digital Technology knowledge, as well as strong communication skills.

**Job Description:**

Product Development

* Define and document comprehensive product requirements, ensuring they are clear, complete, and aligned with business objectives and technical feasibility.
* Gather and evaluate inputs to develop Lean Business Cases and inform WSJF (Weighted Shortest Job First) value scoring
* Accurately and completely define capabilities and features in the Jira Align work planning tool.

Delivery & Execution

* Partner with DCP team to guide and support the development process, providing direction, clarifications, and timely feedback.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure initiatives are delivered on time, at high quality, and in alignment with business needs and technical constraints.
* Escalate risks and issues proactively, working with stakeholders to identify and implement effective solutions.
* Conduct thorough user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate that developed capabilities meet requirements and deliver a positive user experience.
* Partner with the Corporate Customer Marketing business-facing team to deliver product demonstrations highlighting new functionality, business value, and overall benefits; create and maintain user guides and documentation, ensuring instructions, screenshots, and references remain accurate and up to date.

Measurement & Optimization

* Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness and impact of Marketing Content initiatives, providing regular reporting.
* Continuously monitor product performance, making data-driven recommendations to refine features, optimize functionality, and enhance overall user experience.

Process Improvement

* Lead initiatives to improve processes and identify opportunities for automation that maximize business value delivery to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify, analyze, and redesign processes within the Content Supply Chain to increase efficiency, effectiveness, and performance.

Additional Responsibilities

* Provide product expertise and collaborate with internal and vendor Service and Support personnel to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Manage software access through processes related to license requests, usage tracking,  
  invoice reconciliations and chargebacks.
* Perform other assigned duties and contribute to initiatives as needed. **REQUIREMENTS:**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience supporting enterprise software or digital platforms.
* Demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing a product backlog.
* Proven ability to define detailed functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience managing mature products with large enterprise user communities.
* Experience partnering with Agile engineering teams.
* Strong stakeholder management across business and technical organizations.
* Experience making prioritization decisions using business value and customer outcomes.
* Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Jira Align, or equivalent product management tools.
* Experience defining KPIs and measuring product success.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Manager as a Cloud Service and Workfront preferred.

title: Director of Product
description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

  

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.  

  

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.  

  

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.  

  

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.  

  

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.  

  

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
* Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insights, and what makes process KPIs meaningful to an enterprise buyer.
* You understand how AI and ML get applied in operational intelligence products. Not just the theory. You have worked through the practical realities of model development, validation, and how insights actually reach end users.
* You have shipped products used by large enterprises. You understand procurement cycles, compliance requirements, and what it takes to get something adopted at scale inside a Fortune 500 organization.
* You have led product teams before. People grew under your management. You know how to give teams real ownership while keeping everyone pointed in the same direction.
* You are technically credible. You can have a substantive conversation with engineers and data scientists about architecture decisions, API design, and data pipeline trade-offs without needing someone to translate.
* You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically about what you use them for and what impact they have had. This is a real expectation, not a checkbox.
* You communicate clearly across very different audiences, from a technical spec reviewed by engineers to a roadmap presentation in front of a board.
You can operate in ambiguous situations without becoming paralyzed. Fast-moving, early stage environments energize rather than frustrate you.  

  

**Education**

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field is required. An MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative or business discipline is a strong plus.

  

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**

* You have built a product roadmap that the whole company believes in and that customers are genuinely excited about.
* You have shipped meaningful improvements to the process intelligence platform that customers are using, talking about, and renewing because of. • The product team is operating well. People have clear ownership, they are growing in their roles, and there is a culture of honest feedback and continuous learning.
* Skan's process intelligence story is sharper and more differentiated in the market. That is visible in customer conversations, analyst coverage, and competitive win rates.
* You have introduced AI-assisted ways of working into how the team runs discovery, writes specifications, and tracks the competitive landscape. It has made a measurable difference.
People across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and leadership come to you when they need the product perspective. You have earned that trust through good judgment and clear communication.  

  

Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate. We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

title: Principal Application Engineer

title: Performance Marketing Expert
description:
About Thotfy

Thotfy is an Indian creator-led marketplace connecting customers with unique products from artisans, hobbyists, small creators, handmade businesses, and emerging brands.

Our mission is to help creators grow their businesses through a marketplace built around a simple principle: **You Win, We Win.**

We are looking for a performance marketing expert who can turn our extensive product catalogue into a consistent source of profitable sales using Meta advertising.

Role Overview

We are looking for a specialist in **Meta Catalog Ads and Advantage+ campaigns** who understands how to advertise large product catalogues, identify winning products, optimize advertising spend, and scale campaigns while maintaining strict profitability targets.

You will be responsible for managing and optimizing Thotfy's product-level advertising strategy across Facebook and Instagram.

This is a hands-on, performance-driven role. We are looking for someone who can demonstrate results, not just manage campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Meta Catalog & Advantage+ Advertising**

* Set up, manage, and optimize Meta Advantage+ catalog campaigns.
* Manage product catalogues, product sets, and dynamic product advertisements.
* Develop strategies to promote the right products to the right audiences.
* Structure campaigns for product testing, scaling, retargeting, and customer acquisition.

**2. Product-Level Performance Optimization**

* Identify winning products using ROAS, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, add-to-cart activity, and purchase data.
* Build a systematic framework to classify products into testing, scaling, and stopping categories.
* Identify products that generate clicks and cart additions but fail to convert.
* Continuously improve product selection, creative performance, and campaign efficiency.

**3. ROAS & Profitability Management**

* Optimize campaigns to achieve Thotfy's minimum target of **6.25x ROAS**.
* Monitor Meta-attributed purchase revenue against advertising spend.
* Develop practical rules for increasing budgets, pausing underperforming products, and reallocating spend.
* Diagnose performance fluctuations and minimize wasted advertising expenditure.

**4. Tracking & Analytics**

* Audit and optimize Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI) tracking.
