title: Product Director- MXDR
description:
**Director, MXDR Product**

**Level**

Director

  

**Function**

Product Engineering & Development — MXDR (Managed Extended Detection & Response)

  

**Experience**

15–20 years, including 5+ years leading a security or infrastructure product at scale

**Role Summary**
================

The Director, MXDR Product owns the MXDR product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, delivery, and outcomes. This person sits at the intersection of engineering, architecture, security operations, sales, and customer success, converting technical capability into a coherent product that customers trust and buy. They will partner closely with the Senior Architect (who continues to own technical architecture) while taking full ownership of product direction, delivery commitments, cross-functional alignment, and executive/customer communication.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Product Ownership & Strategy**
--------------------------------

* Own the MXDR product roadmap end-to-end — define priorities, sequence releases, and make explicit trade-off calls between customer asks, competitive pressure, and technical debt.
* Translate market and customer signal (win/loss reviews, analyst reports, competitive intelligence, compliance requirements like FedRAMP/SOC 2) into a defensible product strategy.
* Own the business case for major initiatives — cost, timeline, staffing, and expected outcome — before they go to engineering, closing the gap between "good architecture" and "fundable roadmap."

**Delivery Ownership**
----------------------

* Own delivery predictability: turn architecture and design work into resourced, sequenced, trackable delivery plans with realistic timelines.
* Run the cadence that keeps delivery visible — regular progress reviews, clear status reporting (RAG/roadmap-vs-actual), and early escalation of risk rather than late surprises.
* Partner with the Senior Architect and engineering leads to convert technical designs into shippable phases with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**
------------------------------------------

* Be the primary product point of contact for CTO, executive leadership, and key customers — comfortable presenting roadmap, risk, and trade-offs to non-technical and executive audiences.
* Manage the inevitable tension between sales commitments, customer requests, and engineering capacity — and be the one who says no, with a clear rationale, when needed.
* Build and maintain trust with cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, SOC/security operations, sales, marketing, customer success, compliance) so the product roadmap reflects real constraints from every side, not just engineering's.

**Ownership & Accountability**
------------------------------

* Take end-to-end accountability for product outcomes — not just what was designed or built, but what shipped, what customers adopted, and what moved the business forward.
* Proactively surface risk (technical, delivery, market, compliance) rather than waiting to be asked — and bring a recommended path forward, not just a problem.
* Own post-release outcomes: adoption, customer feedback, support burden, and whether the product delivered the value it was built for.

**Domain & Technical Fluency**
------------------------------

* Be fluent enough in MXDR/SOC concepts (detection engineering, threat hunting, SIEM/UEBA/ITDR, incident response workflows, MITRE ATT&CK) to have a credible technical conversation with architects, customers, and analysts — without needing to be the one designing the models.
* Understand the compliance and certification landscape relevant to security products (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, GDPR) well enough to factor it into roadmap decisions early, not as an afterthought.
* Expertise in building AI based SDLC using AI tools.

**AI/ML, LLM, and Innovation Strategy**

* **GenAI & LLM Integration:** Design the architectural blueprint for embedding Generative AI and LLMs (via commercial APIs like OpenAI/Anthropic or open-source models like Llama/Mistral) into our existing products to deliver next-generation customer value.
* **Machine Learning Pipelines:** Leverage the **Python** ecosystem to oversee the creation of scalable ML data pipelines, MLOps frameworks, and predictive modeling features that enhance our application's intelligent capabilities.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):** Architect advanced RAG systems combining **Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch as a vector database)** and SQL to enable high-performance, context-aware semantic search and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* **AI Security & Governance:** Establish enterprise-wide compliance, data privacy (preventing PII leakage into LLMs), and ethical guardrails for AI usage, ensuring alignment with emerging global AI regulations.
* **Internal AI Automation:** Lead initiatives to leverage AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and automated testing tools to improve overall engineering team velocity and code quality.

**Executive Technology Strategy & Enterprise Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Long-Term Technical Vision**: Define and execute a 3-to-5-year technology roadmap that scales with the company’s business growth, shifting engineering from a reactive delivery unit to a proactive business driver.
* **Polyglot Stack Governance:** Establish modern architectural guardrails and engineering standards for our composite ecosystem—ensuring seamless, secure integration between enterprise Angular frontends, distributed Python services, and high-performance .NET Web APIs.
* **Enterprise Data & Search Strategy:** Architect the future state of our data layer; guide principal engineers in optimizing high-transaction SQL databases (replication, partitioning) alongside massive Elastic Stack (ELK) clusters utilized for real-time search, analytics, and observability.
* **R&D and Innovation Leadership**: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI/ML capabilities to determine their business viability, running targeted Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) to maintain market competitiveness.

title: Branch Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead branch setup and operational readiness, drive business growth in gold lending, build and manage a high-performing branch team, and ensure strict compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory (RBI) guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branch Recruitment & Team Building:**
* Source, interview, and hire local talent for key branch roles, including Gold Valuers/Appraisers, Customer Service Officers, Relationship Managers, and Security Personnel.
* Coordinate with HR to manage local hiring pipelines, campus/walk-in drives, and employee onboarding.
* Plan branch staffing levels based on business volume and operational requirements.
* Oversee initial product, compliance, and gold-appraisal training for newly onboarded staff.
* **Business Development & Sales:**
* Drive branch sales targets for gold loan disbursements, cross-selling products, and new customer acquisition.
* Execute local marketing activities and maintain relationships with local business communities to generate leads.
* Oversee loan renewal mix and repeat customer retention strategies.
* **Gold Operations & Risk Management:**
* Ensure accurate gold testing, weighing, and purity assessment following standard appraisal protocols.
* Strictly adhere to Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits and regulatory guidelines.
* Supervise safe vault management, dual-custody procedures, and daily packet verification to protect pledged gold assets.
* **Operations & Compliance:**
* Oversee daily branch transactions, cash management, and operational workflows.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms.
* Ensure smooth internal and external audit processes and resolve audit queries promptly.
* **Portfolio & Recovery Management:**
* Track overdue loans and lead recovery efforts for early-stage delinquent accounts (0–30 days past due).
* Coordinate loan closure, redemption processes, and statutory auctions for non-performing accounts per legal guidelines.
* **Team Leadership & Customer Service:**
* Manage, mentor, and retain branch staff, providing regular performance evaluations and coaching.
* Resolve escalated customer grievances and ensure high-quality service delivery.

* **Hiring & Retention:** Time-to-fill for open branch positions, staff onboarding timeline, and branch attrition rate.

* **Soft Skills:** Talent acquisition, team leadership, conflict resolution, sales strategy, and local language proficiency.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

segmentation and campaign execution through engagement, conversion, and performance measurement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Database Reactivation & Win-Back Funnels: Build, write, launch, and optimize targeted reactivation email

campaigns for historical and lapsed users. Develop messaging that communicates the value of the modernized,

ad-free product experience, ease of setup, workflow efficiency, and minimal operational disruption.

* Product-Led Growth (PLG) & Lifecycle Marketing: Build and manage automated lifecycle campaigns triggered by

user behavior and product-usage milestones. Own the user journey from free sign-up or trial through

engagement, activation, and premium conversion.

* Campaign Development & Optimization: Create segmented, targeted, and multi-channel campaigns using

lifecycle marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Intercom, Marketo, or similar tools. Test messaging, audiences,

timing, and conversion paths to improve acquisition and subscription outcomes.

* Field Marketing, Local Meetups & Roadshows: Plan, coordinate, and host localized user meetups, workshops,

and roadshows designed to re-engage free and lapsed users. Work with existing Spiceworks community

chapters to build local participation and create meaningful user interactions.

* Event-Led Acquisition: Partner with internal product experts to deliver engaging user sessions, ensuring

technical product demonstrations are complemented by clear value messaging and a defined digital conversion

journey.

* Community & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Community Manager to understand forum

sentiment, identify opportunities within the community, and turn relevant discussions and engagement into

acquisition opportunities.

* Performance & Insights: Track acquisition velocity, engagement, reactivation, free-to-paid conversion, and

campaign performance. Use data and event feedback to identify opportunities, improve campaigns, and provide

actionable insights to Product Management.

* End-to-End Ownership: Take personal ownership of growth initiatives from audience selection and campaign

creation through launch, measurement, optimization, and reporting.

**Job Qualifications**

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in B2B SaaS growth marketing, user acquisition, lifecycle marketing, product-

led growth, or a closely related discipline.

* Demonstrated experience building and executing automated lifecycle campaigns using tools such as HubSpot,

Intercom, Marketo, or similar marketing automation platforms.

* Hands-on experience with user segmentation, behavioral targeting, email journeys, conversion funnels, and

campaign optimization.

* Experience organizing and executing community events, user meetups, workshops, roadshows, or other field

marketing initiatives.

* Strong growth-oriented copywriting skills, with the ability to translate product capabilities and updates into clear,

compelling user benefits.

* Strong analytical mindset with comfort working with user data, acquisition metrics, conversion rates, campaign

performance, and growth targets.

* Ability to work independently, move quickly, experiment, learn from results, and take ownership of execution.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly when partnering with Product,

Required Education and/or Experience:

title: Site Operations & Inventory Control Manager
description:
**Job Description \- Site Operations \& Inventory Control Manager**

**Role Overview:**

The **Site Operations \& Inventory Control Manager** will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end ecommerce fulfillment site operations, including inbound, putaway, inventory control, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, cycle count, stock reconciliation, vendor discrepancy reporting, manpower productivity, SLA adherence, and SOP compliance.The role will act as the **single point of ownership for site performance, inventory accuracy, inbound quality, process discipline, and operational issue resolution**. The person will ensure that the warehouse operates efficiently, stock records remain accurate, and all incoming and outgoing inventory movements are controlled as per brand standards.

**You should apply if you have:**

* A strong interest in Site Operations and Inventory Control Management.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills for ecommerce warehouse and fulfilment operations
* A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to work in fast\-paced, high\-growth environment
* Ownership\-driven attitude—comfortable taking charge of projects end\-to\-end
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines

**You should not apply if you:**

* Struggle with ownership and require constant supervision to drive tasks
* Are uncomfortable working with data, numbers, or analytical problem\-solving
* Are not willing to collaborate with cross\-functional teams or external partners
* Avoid negotiation, communication, or vendor/brand interaction

**Skills Required**

* Strong understanding of ecommerce warehouse and fulfilment operations.
* Good command over inbound, GRN, inventory control, dispatch, returns, and audit processes.
* Knowledge of SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, barcode, PO, invoice, ASN, GRN, and stock adjustment processes.
* Strong attention to detail and counting accuracy.
* Ability to identify stock discrepancies, quality issues, and process gaps.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets / MIS reporting skills.
* Understanding of WMS, OMS, ERP, and courier systems; Vinculum knowledge preferred.
* Ability to manage third\-party manpower and ensure SOP compliance.

**What you will do:**

**1\. End\-to\-End Site Operations Management**

* Own daily warehouse / darkstore operations including inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and inventory control.
* Ensure orders are processed within defined cut\-off times and SLA timelines.
* Monitor daily order volume, pending orders, aging orders, SLA breaches, and operational bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with central operations, logistics, product, inventory planning, procurement, finance, and customer support teams.
* Ensure smooth order fulfilment across B2C, marketplace, darkstore, and other ecommerce channels, wherever applicable.

**2\. SLA \& Performance Management**

* Track and improve key operational metrics, including order processing TAT, dispatch TAT, pick\-pack accuracy, inventory accuracy, manpower productivity, and order breach percentage.
* Review site performance daily through dashboards, MIS, exception reports, and pending trackers.
* Identify recurring operational issues and drive corrective actions.
* Prepare daily / weekly performance updates for leadership review.
* Highlight operational risks proactively with root cause and action plan.

**3\. Inventory Accuracy \& Stock Governance**

* Ensure accurate stock storage, bin mapping, SKU hygiene, batch tracking, expiry tracking, FEFO / FIFO adherence, and stock reconciliation.
* Conduct and supervise daily, weekly, and monthly cycle counts as per audit plan.
* Verify physical stock against system stock at SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, and bin level.
* Identify stock mismatches, short / excess quantities, wrong bin placements, missing labels, unscannable barcodes, and location errors.
* Monitor shrinkage, damaged stock, expired stock, dead stock, slow\-moving stock, and high\-value inventory.
* Ensure expired, damaged, leaked, or unsellable stock is quarantined and marked correctly.
* Maintain strict controls for high\-value, fast\-moving, fragile, and expiry\-sensitive SKUs.

**4\. Inbound Audit \& GRN Control**

* Audit incoming stock against PO, invoice, ASN, delivery challan, and system records.
* Verify SKU name, SKU code, quantity, batch number, expiry date, MRP, barcode, and packaging condition.
* Ensure received stock matches system expectations before GRN closure.
* Identify shortages, excess quantity, wrong SKUs, duplicate items, damaged products, near\-expiry stock, expired stock, leakage, tampering, or invoice mismatch.
* Validate GRN entries for accuracy and ensure all discrepancies are recorded before stock acceptance.
* Prevent unauthorized inwarding of stock without PO or required approval.
* Ensure only audited and approved stock moves to putaway.

**5\. Vendor, Transporter \& Discrepancy Management**

* Report vendor\-side and transporter\-side issues such as wrong dispatch, short supply, excess supply, damaged goods, expiry mismatch, MRP mismatch, or invoice mismatch.
* Capture proper evidence through photos, quantity records, signed discrepancy notes, and audit reports.
* Maintain inbound discrepancy logs, rejection reports, vendor issue reports, damage reports, and GRN correction records.
* Coordinate with procurement, planning, finance, and warehouse teams for discrepancy closure.
* Track vendor discrepancy closure and ensure repeated issues are escalated with data.

**6\. Putaway, Storage \& Bin Discipline**

* Ensure stock is moved from the receiving area to the correct storage / bin location within defined TAT.
* Validate correct labeling, barcode scanning, batch tagging, expiry marking, and SKU placement before storage.
* Prevent wrong putaway of unaudited or rejected stock.
* Ensure bin accuracy across racks, storage zones, pick faces, and bulk locations.
* Identify mixed SKUs, wrong bin mapping, wrong batch placement, and missing labels.
* Coordinate correction of bin\-level discrepancies with warehouse team.

**7\. Team \& Manpower Management**

* Monitor whether warehouse staff, supervisors, pickers, packers, auditors, and third\-party manpower are following brand\-defined SOPs.
* Plan manpower as per order load, sale days, campaigns, and business peaks.
* Conduct daily briefings to align teams on order priorities, pending workload, SLA risks, and process discipline.
* Track manpower productivity and identify areas of underutilization or bottleneck.
* Ensure clear shift\-wise ownership for inbound, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and audits.

**8\. Process Compliance \& Site Audit**

* Ensure SOP adherence across inbound, storage, putaway, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, cycle count, and stock adjustment processes.
* Perform site audits in accordance with brand guidelines.
* Maintain documentation for audits, stock movements, damages, GRN, dispatches, returns, rejected stock, and stock adjustments.
* Ensure all stock adjustments are properly documented and approved as per the process.
* Support internal and external audits with required data and records.
* Ensure safety, hygiene, security, and compliance standards are followed at the site.

**9\. Returns \& Reverse Inventory Control**

* Ensure returned stock is received, audited, QC\-checked, and moved to the correct inventory status.
* Validate return discrepancies such as wrong item received, missing item, damaged item, used product, or non\-sellable return.
* Track return\-to\-sellable %, return QC TAT, and rejected return stock.
* Coordinate with customer support, logistics, and finance teams for return closure and refund\-related dependencies.

**10\. Issue Resolution \& Escalation**

* Act as the first escalation point for site\-level operational and inventory\-related issues.
* Resolve issues related to stock mismatch, GRN errors, order delays, manpower shortage, courier handover delays, return discrepancies, system discrepancies, and damaged stock.
* Prepare RCA for repeated inventory mismatches, inbound discrepancies, dispatch delays, and SOP deviations.
* Escalate critical risks proactively with data, business impact, and corrective action plan.

**Work Experience**

**3–5 years** in ecommerce operations, warehouse management, inventory control, inbound operations, stock audit, darkstore operations, retail fulfillment, supply chain operations, FMCG, supplement, pharma\-like product handling, or logistics operations.Experience in a **D2C, ecommerce, supplement, FMCG, pharma, beauty, or personal care warehouse** will be preferred because these categories require tighter control over expiry, batch, MRP, damage, leakage, and return quality.

**Working days: 6 Days** 

**WorkingLocation:** Survey no. 47, mylapura village, jadigennahalli hobli, Hoskote Taluk, Begaluru Rural District, Pincode 562114

**Perks:**

* Friendly atmosphere
* High learning \& personal growth opportunity
* Flexible Timings
* Diverse work environment

**Why Nutrabay:**

We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life’s best work. title: Branch Manger
description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced and responsible **Branch Manager** to manage the day\-to\-day operations of our Salon \& Skin Clinic. The Branch Manager will be responsible for ensuring smooth branch operations, achieving sales targets, managing staff, and maintaining excellent customer service.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Branch Operations**

* Manage the overall day\-to\-day operations of the branch.
* Ensure the salon/clinic is clean, organised and running smoothly.
* Monitor appointments, walk\-ins, customer flow and service schedules.
* Ensure all SOPs, hygiene and operational standards are followed.
* Coordinate with management for branch requirements, inventory and maintenance.

**2\. Sales \& Revenue**

* Take ownership of monthly branch sales and revenue targets.
* Drive service sales, product sales, packages and memberships.
* Follow up on leads, enquiries and inactive customers.
* Monitor daily sales and identify opportunities to improve revenue.
* Track staff\-wise sales and performance.
* Prepare and share daily/weekly/monthly sales reports.

**3\. Staff Management**

* Manage and coordinate all branch staff including beauticians, hairdressers, therapists, skin specialists and front\-office staff.
* Prepare staff schedules and manage shifts/week\-offs.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality and grooming.
* Set individual targets and monitor staff performance.
* Conduct regular team meetings and provide feedback.
* Handle staff concerns and coordinate with HR/management when required.
* Ensure adequate staffing during peak hours.

**4\. Customer Experience**

* Ensure every customer receives a high\-quality experience.
* Handle customer complaints and resolve issues professionally.
* Monitor customer feedback and reviews.
* Encourage repeat visits, memberships and package renewals.
* Maintain strong relationships with regular and VIP customers.

**5\. Inventory \& Cash Management**

* Monitor stock levels and coordinate timely replenishment.
* Prevent wastage and pilferage of salon/clinic products.
* Maintain proper records of products and consumables.
* Coordinate with the accounts team regarding daily collections, expenses and reconciliation.

**6\. Reporting \& Coordination**

* Maintain daily branch reports covering:
* Sales
* Appointments
* Walk\-ins
* Staff attendance
* Service performance
* Product sales
* Customer complaints
* Inventory
* Coordinate with HR, Accounts, Marketing and Management.
* Escalate operational or staff issues to management on time.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly branch revenue
* Sales target achievement
* Service and product sales
* Customer retention \& repeat visits
* Package/membership sales
* Staff productivity
* Customer satisfaction
* Attendance and staff discipline
* Inventory control
* Branch profitability

**Candidate Profile**

* 2–5\+ years of experience in salon, spa, skin clinic, wellness, retail or hospitality management.
* Strong people\-management and sales skills.
* Good communication and customer\-handling skills.
* Ability to manage targets and a team.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and daily reporting.
* Should be proactive, responsible and capable of independently managing a branch.

Pay: From ₹35,000\.00 per month

title: Customer Relationship Executive
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and empathetic Relationship Manager to join our Relationship Marketing team at KoinBX. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our users throughout their lifecycle — from their very first sign\-up and KYC verification to becoming confident, active traders on the platform.

You will own the end\-to\-end user onboarding experience, conduct user interviews to uncover pain points and feature needs, and serve as the voice of the customer to internal product and leadership teams. The ideal candidate combines strong communication skills with a genuine curiosity about user behaviour and a passion for crypto and Web3\.

Key Responsibilities

Onboarding \& User Support

* Guide new users through the complete onboarding journey — account creation, KYC verification, first deposit, and first trade — ensuring a smooth, friction\-free experience.
* Proactively identify and resolve onboarding drop\-offs by reaching out to stalled users via calls, emails, or in\-app messages.
* Maintain a structured onboarding playbook and continuously update it based on user feedback and product changes.
* Track and report onboarding completion rates, time\-to\-first\-trade, and other funnel metrics weekly.

User Research \& Interviews

* Plan, schedule, and conduct structured user interviews (1\-on\-1 calls, surveys, feedback sessions) to deeply understand user pain points, motivations, and trading behaviour.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative user insights into actionable reports for the Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
* Build and maintain a user research repository — tagging insights by theme (e.g., UX friction, feature requests, trust concerns, pricing feedback).
* Recruit and manage a panel of power users and early adopters for ongoing beta testing and feedback loops.

Relationship Marketing \& Retention

* Design and execute lifecycle campaigns (welcome sequences, re\-engagement, milestone celebrations) in coordination with the Marketing team.
* Segment the user base by activity level, trading volume, and engagement score to personalise outreach and retention strategies.
* Own NPS, CSAT, and user health score tracking; flag at\-risk cohorts and implement targeted win\-back initiatives.
* Drive referral program adoption and community engagement by nurturing relationships with high\-value and high\-influence users.

Internal Communication \& Advocacy

* Act as the "Voice of the Customer" — regularly present user insights, recurring complaints, and feature requests to the Product Manager, Design Lead, and senior leadership.
* Collaborate with the Customer Support team to escalate systemic issues and close the loop on user\-reported bugs.
* Prepare weekly and monthly user sentiment reports with clear, data\-backed recommendations for cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Partner with Marketing on user testimonials, case studies, and community content by identifying and nurturing brand advocates.

Required Qualifications

* 2–5 years of experience in Relationship Management, Customer Success, Account Management, or User Research — preferably in a fintech, crypto, or high\-growth product company.
* Demonstrated experience in conducting user interviews, surveys, and qualitative research.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Hindi is must and other regional languages is a plus.
* Empathetic, patient, and user\-first mindset — you genuinely enjoy helping people solve problems.
* Analytical thinking: comfort with data, funnels, and metrics (onboarding rates, NPS, CSAT, retention cohorts).
* Self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment with minimal hand\-holding.

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience in the cryptocurrency, blockchain, or Web3 industry.
* Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Freshdesk, Intercom, or similar) and engagement platforms (CleverTap, MoEngage, or similar).
* Background in UX research methodologies (jobs\-to\-be\-done, usability testing, journey mapping).
* Experience with lifecycle marketing tools and campaign design.
* Familiarity with Indian regulatory context for crypto — KYC/AML flows, FIU\-IND compliance, VDA taxation basics.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Psychology, or a related field.

Key Competencies

* Empathy \& Active Listening — Ability to make users feel heard and translate emotions into structured insights.
* Ownership \& Accountability — Takes full ownership of user outcomes from first touch to resolution.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration — Works seamlessly with Product, Design, Engineering, Support, and Marketing.
* Data\-Informed Storytelling — Turns raw feedback and numbers into compelling narratives that drive action.
* Adaptability — Comfortable navigating shifting priorities in a fast\-moving crypto startup.
* Problem Solving — Identifies root causes rather than surface symptoms; proposes solutions, not just escalations.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives.
* Front\-row seat in one of India's fastest\-growing crypto exchanges.
* Direct impact on user experience and product roadmap — your insights shape what we build.
* A collaborative, transparent, and low\-ego team culture.

Pay: From ₹18,000\.00 per month

Job Summary

The Branch Manager will be responsible for the overall management and performance of the branch, including business development, customer acquisition, team management, loan operations, collections, compliance, and achievement of branch targets. The role requires strong leadership, sales, operational, and customer relationship management skills.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Business Development \& Sales**

* Achieve branch\-wise monthly and annual business targets.
* Drive loan disbursement, gold loan, investment/NCD, insurance, and other assigned financial products.
* Generate new business through customer visits, referrals, local marketing, and business development activities.
* Develop and maintain relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Monitor daily business performance and take corrective action to achieve targets.
* Identify new business opportunities within the branch's market area.

**2\. Branch Operations**

* Ensure smooth and efficient day\-to\-day branch operations.
* Monitor cash, gold, documents, registers, systems, and other branch assets.
* Ensure proper completion and verification of KYC and loan documentation.
* Maintain branch records and ensure timely submission of reports to the Regional/Head Office.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs and operational guidelines.

**3\. Gold Loan Operations** *(where applicable)*

* Ensure proper gold appraisal, documentation, custody, and release procedures.
* Monitor gold loan outstanding, renewals, closures, auctions, and overdue accounts.
* Ensure compliance with prescribed gold\-loan procedures and security standards.
* Immediately report any discrepancy, suspected fraud, or spurious\-gold\-related issue to the concerned authority.

**4\. Team Management**

* Lead, motivate, and monitor branch staff to achieve business and operational targets.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor individual employee performance.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews.
* Support recruitment, induction, training, and development of branch employees.
* Address employee performance and disciplinary issues in coordination with HR/Regional Management.

**5\. Customer Service**

* Maintain high standards of customer service and customer satisfaction.
* Handle customer complaints and ensure timely resolution.
* Build long\-term relationships with customers and improve customer retention.
* Ensure transparent communication of product terms, charges, interest rates, and applicable procedures.

**6\. Collections \& Recovery**

* Monitor overdue accounts and ensure timely follow\-up with customers.
* Coordinate with collection/recovery teams for overdue and NPA accounts.
* Conduct customer visits where required for recovery and business follow\-up.
* Ensure recovery activities are carried out in accordance with company policies and applicable regulations.

**7\. Compliance \& Risk Management**

* Ensure strict compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, KYC/AML requirements, and applicable laws.
* Maintain proper branch records and documentation.
* Ensure audit observations are addressed within the prescribed timeline.
* Prevent operational lapses, fraud, and financial irregularities.
* Cooperate with internal, statutory, and regulatory audits and inspections.

**8\. Reporting \& Review**

* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly branch performance reports.
* Monitor key performance indicators including business growth, collections, customer acquisition, overdue/NPA, and staff productivity.
* Participate in review meetings with Cluster/Regional/Head Office teams.
* Take immediate corrective action when branch performance is below expectations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Branch business achievement
* Loan disbursement and outstanding growth
* Gold loan business and portfolio quality
* Customer acquisition and retention
* Collection and recovery performance
* Reduction of overdue/NPA accounts
* Staff productivity and target achievement
* Audit and compliance performance

title: Director- Marketing
description:
We are **Infrrd** , an Enterprise AI company helping global enterprises extract data from complex, unstructured documents like invoices, contracts, engineering drawings, and handwritten notes. Our AI goes beyond data extraction to automate end\-to\-end workflows, reducing manual effort, improving accuracy, and accelerating business operations.  



  

  

Our product is proven, enterprise customers are live, and we're ready to scale. We're looking for a **Director – Marketing** to bring strategic direction, sharper execution, and stronger business impact to our marketing function.  



  

  

You'll work closely with the founders, Sales leadership, and our existing marketing team to define
  

where we play, who we target, how we position Infrrd, and how marketing drives pipeline and growth. You'll provide the strategy and direction while empowering the team to execute.  



  

  

**What You'll Own**

* Set and drive the overall marketing strategy aligned with business, GTM, and revenue objectives.
* Provide strategic direction to our existing Demand Generation team, helping sharpen targeting, channel strategy, campaign priorities, and performance.
* Partner closely with Sales to define and refine our ICP, target segments, personas, buyer journeys, and account strategy.
* Develop an integrated demand and growth strategy across inbound, ABM, digital, content, events, and other relevant channels.
* Own marketing's contribution to pipeline growth, with clear metrics, priorities, and accountability.
Identify opportunities across the funnel and improve awareness engagement qualified demand pipeline* revenue.
* Shape our product marketing, positioning, and messaging, translating complex Enterprise AI capabilities into compelling stories for enterprise buyers.
* Strengthen Infrrd's brand and market presence through content, customer stories, thought leadership, website, and industry initiatives.
* Work with Sales on sales enablement, messaging, account engagement, and pipeline acceleration.
* Establish the right KPIs, attribution, and reporting to measure marketing effectiveness and guide investment.
* Build strong collaboration across Marketing, Sales, Product, and Leadership.
Develop existing marketing talent and help evolve the organization as the company scales.  
* 

  

  

**What We're Looking For**

* 10–15 years of experience in B2B marketing in B2B SaaS, Enterprise SaaS, AI, or technology companies.
* Proven experience in a marketing leadership role, setting strategy across multiple marketing functions.
* Strong background in demand generation and growth marketing, with a track record of influencing pipeline and revenue.
* Experience partnering with Sales leadership on ICP, GTM strategy, segmentation, and pipeline growth.
* Strong understanding of enterprise B2B buying journeys, complex sales cycles, and ABM.
* Experience across areas such as demand generation, product marketing, content, digital, brand, and events.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with the ability to connect marketing activity to business outcomes.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex technology into compelling business value.
* A strategic thinker who is also comfortable getting into the details when needed.
* Strong people leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to provide direction, develop talent, and build the function as we scale.
Experience in Enterprise AI, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), Document Automation, or Enterprise SaaS is a strong plus.  
* 

  

  

**Why Join Us**

* Shape the marketing strategy for an Enterprise AI company at a defining stage of growth.
* Work closely with the founders and executive leadership and influence company strategy.
* Lead and provide direction to an existing marketing team and help take its impact to the next level.
* Work on meaningful GTM challenges at the intersection of AI, enterprise software, and complex workflows.
* Have a direct connection between your work and pipeline, growth, and business outcomes.
Join a culture where ideas are welcomed, ownership is real, and challenging the status quo is encouraged.  
* 

  

Think you're excited by the challenge? We'd love to hear from you.  



  

By submitting your application, you agree that your personal information and resume may be collected, processed, and stored by us for recruitment purposes, including consideration for future roles.
